response_fields.description: Name of the Merchant Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:Greensky LLC Allowable Values: 20

response_fields.description: Masked Card Number.For security purposes, the card number always displays partially masked with only the first six and last four numbers in the clear. Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456XXXXXX1234 Allowable Values: 19
